description: This file defines a VercelAiGatewayHandler class that extends RouterProvider to handle AI chat completions via Vercel's AI Gateway API, including message creation, prompt completion, and usage tracking.

classes.name: VercelAiGatewayHandler
classes.description: A class that manages AI chat interactions with Vercel's AI Gateway, including message creation and prompt completion.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a chat message stream based on system prompt, messages, and metadata, handling streaming responses and usage data.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt synchronously by calling the Vercel AI Gateway API and returning the generated text.
